Rebalance every N trading days; >1 lowers turnover
One-way commission+slippage assumption (research only; do not lower to 'fix' net)
Constraint target; agent may relax slightly if unattainable after fixes
Max allowed drawdown magnitude (positive number, e.g. 0.35 = 35%)
Factor names to drop from composite (append via full list in patch)
Subset of method ids to sweep (empty = all)
